stem:
The diagram shows the shadow of a tree in a field at noon on a summer day.
The sun rises at 7:00 A.M. on this day. Which diagram best shows the shadow of the tree at 10:00 A.M. on the same day?

options.label: F
options.text:
West          East
[Illustration of shadow to the right of tree with sun on the left]

options.label: G
options.text:
West          East
[Illustration of shadow to the left of tree with sun on the right]

options.label: H
options.text:
West          East
[Illustration of tree with sun far to the right and no visible shadow]

options.label: J
options.text:
West          East
[Illustration of shadow to the right of tree with sun on the left but longer shadow than F]

visual_elements: Diagram of tree with shadow at noon labeled west and east
Diagram F with sun on left and shadow to right
Diagram G with sun on right and shadow to left
Diagram H with sun on right and no shadow
Diagram J with sun on left and longer shadow to right
